text.legend: Received = usable goods sorted in; picked = filled onto requests; adjustments = manual inventory corrections (net). Outdated, trashed and diverted goods are not stock and don't change on-hand. Moving a pallet changes where stock is, not how much, so it isn't shown. Quantities are in each item's own unit, so totals across different items mix units.

text.how_it_works_paragraph: Only the first team at each station needs staged goods: teams move from station N to N+1, so after its first stop every team works on what it handled itself one station earlier. Receiving uses your own goods (not scanned): put out boxes to receive, and the teams sort what they bring in. Stations 3–5 hold the scanned goods, placed as listed below. When a team marks a load delivered (Station 6, Round 2), carry that box back to Receiving as a new delivery.
